trap.label: by + -ing
trap.wrong: I would like to begin by introduce the topic.
trap.right: I would like to begin by introducing the topic.
trap.why: Em português “começar por apresentar” usa infinitivo depois da preposição. Em inglês, depois de preposição, use -ing.

fix.wrong: Today I’ll be talk about costs.
fix.right: Today I’ll be talking about costs.

fix.wrong: That bring me to the cost breakdown.
fix.right: That brings me to the cost breakdown.

fix.wrong: I’d be happy to take questions of the committee.
fix.right: I’d be happy to take questions from the committee.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com begin by: “First I will thank you.”
rewrite.answer: I would like to begin by thanking you.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com What matters: “The cost is the most important thing.”
rewrite.answer: What matters most is the cost.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com That brings me to: “Now the cost breakdown.”
rewrite.answer: That brings me to the cost breakdown.
